setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays one trig on step 1: root C (MIDI 60, C3) at velocity 50, held for 4 steps. Chd1 to Chd4 on the Masks page are E, G, A and C (MIDI 64, 67, 69, 72) and the output is polyphonic. Trig params is open on its parameter list, showing Chord Note Arpeggio. No slot is assigned yet.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Note Arpeggio to the first slot and K2 to return, then turn E3 up to 1/2. Turn E2 to the next slot, press K2 and turn E3 to Chord Pattern.
steps.title: Set a half-step Arpeggio

steps.caption: An arpeggio gives every note its own gate: each note lasts one division, here half a step, from its own start. A strummed note is held to the end of the step. Assign Chord Pattern and turn E3 one detent to -> (forward); Assign Mute Chord Root and leave it at X so the root still sounds; then assign Chord Velocity Mod and turn E3 to +10 (E2 moves to the next slot, K2 opens the list, E3 browses, K3 assigns, K2 returns). Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. In the MIDI strip the five voices start half a step apart: C3 (60), E3 (64), G3 (67), A3 (69) and C4 (72).
steps.title: Hear a gate on every voice

title: Give every arp voice its own gate
